service.description: Out-parameters every connector extract returns: the automation edge and the run pipeline read them by name off every side's extract (SourceSystemConnector.extractServiceName). A script service returns only declared out-parameters, so a missing one reads as "no data" rather than as a wiring error.

A staged connection probe (SourceSystemConnector.healthCheckServiceName), dispatched only by facade.SettingsFacadeServices.test#SourceConnection, which owns the permission gate, resolves the config and passes it under the row's configParameterName (so the config id is each probe's own in-parameter). Read-only; never writes to ec.message: a refused credential is a check row, not a service error.

parameter.name: stage
parameter.description: Run just this stage and report the next one, so the caller can show progress as each completes. Blank runs every stage in a single call; "@first" (SourceConnectionDiagnosticsSupport.STAGE_FIRST) is whichever stage the probe runs first.

parameter.name: nextStage
parameter.description: Stage to run next, or blank when the probe is finished: either it completed or a failure made the remaining stages meaningless.
